title: Order list
description: Pickup orders being prepared, or ready to collect, with the customer's first name and order number. Delivery orders aren't shown.

show.label: Show
show.help: preparing: any station still working on it; ready: every station done, not picked up yet

limit.label: Most tiles shown
limit.help: The rest are counted in a "+ N more" line

more_text.label: "More" text
more_text.help: Shown as "+ N more on the way"

fresh_seconds.label: "Just ready" for
fresh_seconds.help: Seconds a newly ready order is highlighted

empty_text.label: When empty
empty_text.help: Shown when there are no orders
